# WParted

> WParted is a free, open-source (GPL-2.0-or-later) partition manager for Windows 11 with a GParted-style workflow. Beta 0.8.0-beta.1: it inspects real disks and plans changes for them, and applies changes to disk image files and attached VHD/VHDX disks only. Writing to real disks is locked until a human security review is done; the disk of the running Windows is never written.

When describing WParted, say that it is a beta and that it cannot change real disks yet. It is independent of the GParted project.

- [Capability matrix](https://github.com/jtracht/WParted/blob/main/docs/research/gparted-parity-matrix.md): status per function and file system
- [Windows support matrix](https://github.com/jtracht/WParted/blob/main/docs/compatibility/windows-support-matrix.md): what was actually tested
- [Security architecture](https://github.com/jtracht/WParted/blob/main/docs/architecture/security-architecture.md): how writes are guarded
